project.title: Workflow review: parallel actions before budget approval

decisions.question: Which actions are the 'parallel actions' in question, and which action is the budget approval Decision? Supply the workflow YAML (or export) so the review can trace action ids, order and executionMode.

Does the procedure allow any work on the request to begin before budget approval is recorded? If yes, which tasks exactly, and what happens to them when the approval is rejected or the request is returned for rework?

Do any of the candidate parallel actions commit the organization (order a supplier, sign a contract, make a payment, reserve funds) or only prepare (collect quotations, draft a specification)? Committing work must not start before approval unless the procedure says so explicitly.

Who holds budget approval authority, and is there a threshold above which a second authority decides? Needed to check owner, segregation between requester/preparer and approver, and the Decision's rejection and return outcomes.
What is the service level for the budget approval Decision and for each parallel action (basis: activation or creation; calendar or workdays)? Without it, due stays unset.
